slides.title: The pilot earned enough demand to justify a second season
slides.subtitle: Neighborhood Learning Exchange | Synthetic demonstration

slides.title: The pilot sustained repeat participation
bullets: Six workshops ran across eight weekends
Sessions covered practical creative and technical skills
Registration stayed open to the full neighborhood
The pilot measured repeat attendance, satisfaction, and delivery capacity

slides.title: Attendance grew while satisfaction held
bullets: 148 participants attended at least one workshop
63 participants returned for a second session
Three sessions filled their waiting lists

slides.title: Volunteer capacity limits expansion
bullets: Six volunteers are trained to lead a full session
Preparation time rose as the schedule became denser
Adding sessions without more facilitators would put quality at risk

slides.title: Scale carefully to preserve quality
bullets: Add two sessions rather than doubling the calendar
Train four additional facilitators before launch
Keep the same feedback and repeat-attendance measures
Review the decision after eight weeks
